text:
Samira Khan: Heads-up - we're targeting a coordinated private-preview listing with Snowflake + Databricks + Milvus connector next week. Need a quick end-to-end validation pass on packaging, ingest, and marketplace metadata. Who's free to run the smoke?

Tom Reynolds: I can run the infra smoke tomorrow morning. what's the sample size?

Samira Khan: 500 docs, avg 300 tokens, and confirm listing fields (logo, short blurb, SKU, retention). Aim to finish by Thu EOD.

Priya Nair: I'll take the marketplace manifest and GTM blurb. Need partner logo and short description from their PM. @Evan can you confirm asset delivery?

Evan Ortiz: Partner said they'll drop assets in the shared drive by COB today. If not, we use placeholder with DRAFT tag. Legal ok with placeholders?

ops-bot: deploy-staging: connector-smoke initiated by Tom Reynolds at 2026-03-24T08:12:00Z

Tom Reynolds: Running smoke with snow-connector, dbx-adapter, and milvus-sidecar. Command: 
```bash
python infra/smoke.py --connectors snow,dbx,milvus --count 500 --parallel 6
```

Tom Reynolds: First run shows 92% success - failures mostly from nested arrays in partner sample and a vector dimension mismatch (partner vectors 128, our Milvus index expects 256). Logs: /var/log/marketplace/smoke-1762345678.log

Priya Nair: 92% isn't great. Ask partner to flatten arrays or provide a normalization script. Also add vector-dim requirement to manifest and README.

Evan Ortiz: I'll request normalized samples and updated vectors. ETA 24h.

Samira Khan: Legal: set staging retention to 7 days and mark listing visibility=private-preview. No external announcement until GA.

Tom Reynolds: Re-ran after partner adjustments. Success 99%. Remaining failures: one timestamp parse edge-case. Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/marketplace/1762345678/report.json

ops-bot: artifact-upload complete for 1762345678

Priya Nair: Manifest PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-manifests/pull/412 — includes vector_dim: 256, retention_days: 7, support_contact.

Samira Khan: OK checklist: assets (Priya/Evan), smoke >=95% (Tom), manifest+README updated (Priya), legal retention + copy (Samira). Reconvene Friday 09:00 PT for final go/no-go.

Evan Ortiz: Partner assets uploaded to drive. I'll post links in this thread when I sync them.

Samira Khan: Great work, team. :white_check_mark:
